description: Defines the interface and data structures for socket connection jobs within the Chromium networking stack, including parameters, callbacks, and the ConnectJob class with its delegate.

classes.name: ConnectJob
classes.description: Abstract interface for establishing socket connections, handling host resolution, TCP, SSL, and proxy authentication, with asynchronous callback support.

classes.name: CommonConnectJobParams
classes.description: Immutable parameters shared across all ConnectJob types, including socket factory, resolver, proxy, and security settings.

classes.name: Delegate
classes.description: Callback interface for connection completion and proxy authentication challenges within ConnectJob.

methods.name: ConnectJob
methods.description: Constructor initializing connection parameters, delegate, and logging.

methods.name: PassSocket
methods.description: Releases ownership of the connected socket to the caller.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Starts the connection process, returning status codes indicating success, pending, or error.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state for connection progress tracking.

methods.name: HasEstablishedConnection
methods.description: Indicates if a TCP connection has been successfully established.

methods.name: GetConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Returns list of failed connection attempts.

methods.name: GetResolveErrorInfo
methods.description: Provides error info from host resolution.

methods.name: IsSSLError
methods.description: Indicates if the last error was an SSL error.

methods.name: GetCertRequestInfo
methods.description: Returns SSL client auth request info if applicable.

methods.name: GetHostResolverEndpointResult
methods.description: Returns DNS route info for the connection.

methods.name: set_done_closure
methods.description: Sets callback to be invoked upon object deletion.
